items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: Yes, Brownlee was the only band that I wasn't the leader of. After that, I started off as a leader, and then I went to work with Brownlee for a while

ctx.x: Let's see if there's anything about the, we kept talking about those later things, anything about in the early days, which we're trying to get all that early history, which most people have forgotten. Can you remember, you said you worked with Brownlee for a while and made those first records, I guess that was your first record date? That was the first record. That was down here, wasn't it? Right here, yeah.

An okay record made. Yeah, it was on Barone Street in Greenwalls. Had you been working with Brownlee for a while, or? Yes, Brownlee was the only band that I wasn't the leader of. After that, I started off as a leader, and then I went to work with Brownlee for a while, and then I organized my band again, and I've been a leader ever since.
He's still over in Pensacola, I think, still. Yes, I think so. Connected to the union over there, I believe they say.
